finance_revalidation_requirements.source_text: FIN-01 | Project must expose total contracted/project financial value | P0
FIN-02 | Project must show total invoices issued | P0
FIN-03 | Project must show total verified/allocated receipts | P0
FIN-04 | Project must calculate outstanding/project balance deterministically | P0
FIN-05 | Financial summary must update from invoice/payment records, not manual spreadsheet arithmetic | P0
INV-01 | Invoice must be created from the correct Project + service scope | P0
INV-02 | User must be able to reuse/clone the previous invoice for that same project | P0
INV-03 | Global invoice numbering must remain sequential | P0
INV-04 | Project-local invoice sequence must remain separately tracked | P0
INV-05 | Invoice date, service period and due date must be separate fields | P0
INV-06 | Invoice line/item/description/amount must remain structured and auditable | P0
INV-07 | Invoice must retain the AMEC payment/bank information through controlled template/account configuration | P1
BILL-01 | Monthly supervision invoices must be identifiable automatically/by work queue | P0
BILL-02 | Supervision invoice should represent the preceding service month | P0
BILL-03 | Design invoices must be triggered by actual contractual/project milestones | P0
BILL-04 | Billing trigger must identify the correct project/service/milestone and eligible amount | P0
DOC-01 | Created invoice must remain linked to its canonical Invoice record | P0
DOC-02 | Issued invoice artifact must be retained | P0
DOC-03 | Delivery evidence must be distinct from Issue | P0
DOC-04 | Client signed/stamped acknowledgement must be linked to that exact invoice | P0
DOC-05 | Payment evidence must be linked to the corresponding payment/receipt | P0
DOC-06 | Historical invoice artifacts must never be silently overwritten | P0
PAY-01 | Record payment evidence | P0
PAY-02 | Verify payment separately from payment claim/evidence | P0
PAY-03 | Allocate verified payment to invoice | P0
PAY-04 | Support partial payment | P0
PAY-05 | Fully allocated invoice becomes Paid/Closed | P0
PAY-06 | Payment allocation updates project receipts and outstanding balance | P0
PAY-07 | Payment allocation remains auditable | P0
GOV-01 | System may prepare invoice drafts | P0
GOV-02 | System may identify billing due/missing work | P0
GOV-03 | System may calculate financial projections | P0
GOV-04 | Human retains invoice issuance/accounting authority | P0
GOV-05 | AI cannot fabricate payment verification | P0
GOV-06 | AI cannot autonomously sign/stamp/approve invoice | P0
GOV-07 | External client sending remains controlled | P0
